between ESSAR GLOBAL LIMITED, a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands (“EGL”
or the “Guarantor” as the case may be), and ESSAR STEEL MINNESOTA LLC, a Minnesota

BRANCH, as Facility Agent (including any successor Facility Agent, the “Facility Agent”) on
behalf of ICICI BANK LIMITED, NEW YORK BRANCH, as a Lender (the “Initial Lender”)
which is a party, and the Subsequent Project Lenders (together with the Initial Lender, the
“Lenders”) from time to time which shall become parties, to the Senior Secured Credit
Agreement, dated as of December 29, 2010 (as restated, amended, supplemented or otherwise
modified from time to time, the “Credit Agreement”), among the Borrower, the Lenders party
thereto, the Issuing Bank, the Agents named therein and ICICI Bank Limited, New York Branch,
as Mandated Lead Arranger.

                                      W I T N E S S E T H:

          WHEREAS, pursuant to the Credit Agreement, the Lenders have agreed to severally
make extensions of credit to the Borrower upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth
therein;

          WHEREAS, the Borrower is a member of an affiliated group of companies that
includes EGL;

           WHEREAS, the proceeds of the extensions of credit under the Credit Agreement will
be used as set forth in the Credit Agreement, and EGL will derive substantial direct and indirect
benefit from the entering into of the Credit Agreement and the making of the extensions of credit
under the Credit Agreement; and

            WHEREAS, it is a condition precedent to the obligation of the Lenders to enter into
the Credit Agreement and to make their respective extensions of credit to the Borrower under the
Credit Agreement that EGL shall have executed and delivered this Agreement for the ratable
benefit of the Lenders;

            NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and to induce the Lenders to
enter into the Credit Agreement and to make their respective extensions of credit to the Borrower
thereunder, EGL hereby agrees, for the ratable benefit of the Lenders, as follows:

                                           ARTICLE I

                                       DEFINED TERMS

        SECTION 1.01         Definitions. Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise defined
shall have the meanings assigned to such terms in the Credit Agreement. In this Agreement,
unless the context requires otherwise, capitalized terms have the following respective meanings:

           “Agreement” means this Guarantee Agreement, as the same may be restated,
amended, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time.
             “Borrower Obligations” means the collective reference to the Obligations (as defined
in the Credit Agreement), including the unpaid principal of and interest on the Term Loans, if

any, or the LC Exposure and all other obligations and liabilities of the Borrower (including,
without limitation, interest accruing at the then applicable rate provided in the Credit Agreement
upon the occurrence of any Default or after the maturity of the Term Loans, if any, and interest
accruing at the then applicable rate provided in the Credit Agreement after the filing of any
petition in bankruptcy, or the commencement of any insolvency, reorganization or like
proceeding, relating to the Borrower, whether or not a claim for post-filing or post-petition
interest is allowed in such proceeding) to the Lenders, whether direct or indirect, absolute or
contingent, due or to become due, or now existing or hereafter incurred, which may arise under,
out of, or in connection with, the Credit Agreement, this Agreement, or the other Loan
Documents, or any Letter of Credit, or any other document made, delivered or given in
connection therewith, in each case whether on account of principal, interest, reimbursement
obligations, fees, indemnities, costs, expenses or otherwise (including, without limitation, all fees
and disbursements of counsel to the Facility Agent or the Lenders that are required to be paid by
the Borrower pursuant to the terms of any of the foregoing agreements).
             “Deficiency” means, as determined by the Borrower or the Required Lenders, any
actual shortfall, howsoever caused, in funds available to the Borrower required:
           (i) for any cost of the Project in excess of one billion ninety seven million Dollars
(US$1,097,000,000) (unless such cost of the Project is increased in connection with a Permitted
Project Change); or
            (ii) any increase in the cost of the Project in excess of that set forth in clause (i) due
to any change in scope of the Project that is not a Permitted Project Change.
             “EGL Guarantee Release Date” means the date following the Commercial Operations
Date when an offtake agreement or agreements, in each case, between the Borrower and Essar
Steel Algoma Inc., Canada, or any other offtaker reasonably acceptable to the Lender or Lenders
at such time whose Term Loan Exposures constitute not less than sixty six and two thirds percent
(66 2/3%) of the total Term Loan Exposure, which provides for the arms’ length actual purchase,
in the aggregate under all such agreements, of at least 2.76 million tons per annum of the iron ore
pellets manufactured by the beneficiation and pellet plant of the Borrower which is included in
the Project, each of which offtake agreements shall be in form and substance and for a term, in
each case, reasonably acceptable to the Lender or Lenders whose Term Loan Exposure constitute
not less than sixty six and two thirds percent (66 2/3%) of the total Term Loan Exposure,
becomes effective, provided, however, the Lenders agree that on or before the satisfaction of the
conditions set forth in Section 4.02 of the Credit Agreement, the Lenders shall negotiate in good
faith with the Borrower with respect to the form and term of a draft pellet purchase agreement
that would be reasonably acceptable to the Lenders with respect to an approved offtaker.
            “Guarantor Obligations” shall have the meaning given such term in Section 2.01(a).
            “Material Adverse Effect” means a material adverse effect on (a) the business,
financial condition, operations or performance or properties of the Guarantor since the date of this
Agreement, (b) the ability of the Guarantor to perform its material obligations under this
Agreement, or (c) the rights of or remedies available to the Lenders under this Agreement.
             “Obligations”: (i) in the case of the Borrower, the Borrower Obligations, and (ii) in
the case of the Guarantor, its Guarantor Obligations.
        SECTION 1.02             Rules of Interpretation. In this Agreement (a) the singular
includes the plural and the plural the singular; (b) words importing any gender include the other

 gender; (c) references to statutes or regulations are to be construed as including all statutory or
 regulatory provisions consolidating, amending or replacing the statute or regulation referred to;
 (d) references to “herein”, “hereof”, “hereto”, “hereunder” and similar terms refer to the
 agreement or document in which they appear, as a whole, and not to any particular section,
 paragraph, or provision of such agreement or document; (e) references to “include”, “includes”
 and “including” are deemed to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, and, the parties
 agree that a general statement which is followed by or referable to an enumeration of specific
 matters shall not be limited to matters similar to the matters specifically mentioned unless

                                             ARTICLE II

         SECTION 2.01         Guarantor Obligations.

              (a) EGL hereby unconditionally and irrevocably, (i) for the period from the date
 hereof to and until satisfaction of all conditions set forth in Sections 4.01 through 4.02 (including,
 in each case Section 4.04) of the Credit Agreement, guarantees to the Lenders the prompt and
 complete payment by the Borrower when due (whether at the stated maturity, by acceleration or
 otherwise) of the Borrower Obligations, (ii) for the period from the date hereof to and until the
 Commercial Operations Date, agrees to provide to the Borrower for the ratable benefit of the
 Borrower and the Lenders, the full and complete amount of any Deficiency when the Deficiency
 arises and the Guarantor receives notice of such Deficiency as set forth in Section 2.02(a) below,
 and (iii) for the period from the Commercial Operations Date and thereafter to and until the EGL
 Guarantee Release Date, guarantees to the Lenders, the prompt and complete payment by the
 Borrower when due (whether at the stated maturity, by acceleration or otherwise) of the Borrower
 Obligations, provided, the maximum amount of EGL’s liability for the Borrower Obligation
 under this clause (iii) shall be limited in the aggregate to $250,000,000, (collectively, the
 foregoing obligations are herein referred to as the “Guarantor Obligations”).


             (b) Anything herein or in any other Loan Document to the contrary notwithstanding,
 (i) the obligations of the Guarantor hereunder are primary and notwithstanding the obligations of

                                                                                             ICICI-000261




any other Person providing any Guarantee, Collateral or other assurance in favor of the Lenders
on behalf of the Borrower Obligations; and (ii) the maximum liability of the Guarantor hereunder
and under the other Loan Documents shall in no event exceed the amount which can be
guaranteed by the Guarantor under applicable federal and state laws relating to fraudulent
conveyances or transfers or the insolvency of debtors.
            (c) The Guarantor agrees that the Borrower Obligations may at any time and from
time to time exceed the amount of the liability of the Guarantor hereunder without impairing the
guarantee of the Guarantor contained in this Section 2.01 or affecting the rights and remedies of
the Facility Agent or any Lender hereunder.

            (d) The guarantee contained in this Section 2.01 shall remain in full force and effect
until the earlier of (i) the EGL Guarantee Release Date, and (ii) the date that all the Borrower
Obligations and the obligations of the Guarantor under the guarantee contained in this Section
2.01 shall have been paid in full in cash, no Letter of Credit shall be outstanding and the Total
Commitments shall be terminated, notwithstanding that from time to time during the term of the
Credit Agreement the Borrower may be free from any Borrower Obligations.
        SECTION 2.02         Deficiency Procedures.

             (a) The Borrower shall notify the Guarantor from time to time to the extent a
Deficiency at any time exists and that the Guarantor provides to the Borrower the amount of the
Deficiency specified in such Deficiency notice. If no action is taken by the Borrower to notify
the Guarantor of a Deficiency, and the Required Lenders at any time determine that a Deficiency
exists, the Facility Agent on behalf of the Required Lenders may give a notice of the Deficiency
in writing to the Guarantor (with a copy to the Borrower), that the Guarantor provide to the
Borrower the amount of the Deficiency specified in such Deficiency notice, which shall include a
certification from the Lender’s Engineering Consultant of the Deficiency amount.

             (b) The parties hereto acknowledge that the Facility Agent and the Lenders shall
have no obligation to issue a notice of Deficiency to demand the provision of funds to the
Borrower to meet a Deficiency in accordance with this Article II and that neither the Facility
Agent nor Lender shall be liable to any party for not demanding any funds or for demanding
insufficient funds under this Article II.

            (d) Any funds required to cover a Deficiency specified in a notice of Deficiency shall
be provided by way of a contribution to the capital of the Borrower or, in accordance with the
provisions and requirements of the Credit Agreement, an Unsecured Subordinated Promoter Loan.
If the Guarantor decides to contribute additional capital to the Borrower, the Borrower shall take all
appropriate action to increase its charter capital and offer to the Guarantor or their Affiliate(s) as
may be specified by the Guarantor the right to make a capital contribution to the Borrower.

             (f) If the Guarantor decides to contribute capital to the Borrower, the Guarantor agrees
to cause Borrower, and the Borrower hereby agrees, to issue and allocate the additional Equity
Interests subscribed and to pay the cost or cost that has created the Deficiency. If the Guarantor
makes an Unsecured Subordinated Promoter Loan, the Guarantor agrees to cause Borrower, and the
Borrower hereby agrees, to use the proceeds of such loan to pay the cost or cost that has created the
Deficiency.

       SECTION 2.03         Subrogation. Notwithstanding any payment made by the Guarantor
hereunder or any set-off or application of funds of the Guarantor by the Facility Agent or any

 Lender, the Guarantor shall not be entitled to be subrogated to any of the rights of the Facility

 Guarantor Obligations, nor shall the Guarantor seek or be entitled to seek any contribution or
